sections.title: Assessment session
sections.markdown: Start interview_005 in the Interview Center. This 60-minute catalog slot contains a 45-minute debugging assessment and 15 minutes of evidence-based feedback. The candidate brief appears at attempt start; reference reasoning belongs to the submitted-attempt debrief. Coaching and exam modes share durable session state and record requested hints.
